logTail: Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit.
A woman, maybe 40s: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

Channel keepsakes from your pack.

◈ FLASHBACK — Mother's Ring
The winter the factory closed Hank pressed this into your hand and said: fix what you can reach. She twisted it when she was thinking, which was always. You twist it now.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Her voice, patient: measure twice. Things can be fixed.
Channel it from your pack. Watch what grief does when the System does the math.
